papers.title_en: Zero-Shot Domain Generalization via Domain Prompt Learning
papers.authors: Shiming Chen, Shuhuang Chen, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
papers.evidence: 通过在CLIP上进行提示学习来学习目标领域知识
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大型视听模型的零样本领域泛化方法——领域提示学习（DoP），它无需源域数据即可识别未见目标域中的未见类别。该方法通过文本和视觉模态的提示学习来克服模态间的领域偏移，在多个标准数据集上显著超越了现有最先进的领域泛化方法。
papers.abstract_en: Domain generalization (DG) aims to improve   the generalization of the model to any unseen domains. Targeting this goal, existing DG methods mainly focus on learning domain-invariant features or prompts from the given source domains. However, these methods rely on source-domain data, and collecting and annotating large-scale single- or multi-source datasets is often infeasible, limiting the practical applicability of DG. To tackle this challenge, we propose {\underline{Do}}main \underline{P}rompt Learning (DoP), a method built on a large vision-language model (e.g., CLIP) for zero-shot domain generalization, which recognizes unseen classes in unseen target domains without access to source-domain data. DoP essentially learns the target domain knowledge via prompt both in text and visual modalities to overcome the domain shift in text-visual modalities under the test-time adaptation formulation. Specifically, DoP first takes text domain learning (TDL) to simulate various distribution shifts by learning diverse style tokens implicitly in the text space with inter-style diversity loss and intra-style consistency loss. Subsequently, DoP employs visual domain learning (VDL) to further refine the target-domain-relevant style token generated by TDL by making use of the test visual data with self-supervised learning. Extensive experiments on popular DG benchmark datasets (e.g., PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome, and DomainNet) and ImageNet show that our DoP consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art DG approaches. Codes are available at: https://github.com/shiming-chen/DoP.

papers.title_en: On the Token Collapse Phenomenon in Textual Graph Soft Prompting
papers.authors: Andrea Giuseppe Di Francesco, Rishabh Jain, Franco Maria Nardini, Nicola Tonellotto, Pietro Liò, Fabrizio Silvestri
papers.evidence: 图软提示与标记折叠现象分析
papers.tldr: 本研究深入分析了将图结构注入大语言模型提示词的图软提示方法（如G-Retriever），揭示了广泛存在的“token崩溃”现象，即图token在不同输入间变得几乎无法区分，实际沦为通用软提示而非传递图内容。
papers.abstract_en: Recent methods for injecting graph structure into LLM prompts include graph soft prompting, in which a graph neural network (GNN) learns graph-specific tokens that capture relational information among entities in textual prompts. G-Retriever combines graph soft prompts with a verbalized description of the same graph to strengthen the textual prompt signal. We conduct an in-depth analysis of G-Retriever and uncover a pathological behavior we term token collapse. Across three benchmarks, three graph encoders, two LLM families, and both frozen and LoRA-adapted models, G-Retriever's graph tokens become almost indistinguishable across inputs. We provide evidence that the same failure is inherited by subsequent methods, even with multi-token pooling. Under the standard setup, swapping a token with the dataset mean, a token from another example, or one derived from a corrupted graph produces no resolved answer-level effect in accuracy. Moreover, a learned constant prompt that never accesses the graph matches or surpasses G-Retriever on all three benchmarks. These findings indicate that, rather than conveying graph content as intended, the collapsed token functions primarily as a generic soft prompt. We also examine conditions linked to this collapse and propose a two-stage procedure that yields non-collapsed tokens while maintaining competitive performance in most cases. However, token variability alone does not prove that the model uses graph information: via interventions and decoding probes, we show that depending on the configuration, a token can reflect the question, an answer prior, or graph-derived content that the LLM may or may not use. Overall, our results offer a practical approach to evaluating graph-token alignment rather than inferring it from task accuracy alone. Code to reproduce our experiments is available at https://github.com/difra100/Token_Collapse_KGQA.

papers.title_en: The Instruction Tax on Factual Recall: Base Models Can Beat Their Instruction-Tuned Counterparts
papers.evidence: 基础模型事实召回的提示方法学
papers.tldr: 本文介绍了作者在AKBC LM-KBC 2026共享任务中的夺冠方案。研究发现，在无需检索和微调的情况下，基础大语言模型在事实检索任务上的表现往往超越其指令微调版本，作者将这种现象称为“指令税”。最终方案结合了少样本提示、多重采样与频率过滤，以及针对特定关系的优化策略，取得了优异的成绩。
papers.abstract_en: We present our solution to the AKBC LM-KBC 2026 Shared Task, where we achieved a score of 0.6836 on the official leaderboard, more than double the baseline of 0.2964. This task requires generating all possible objects for subject-relation pairs using a language model with up to 32 billion parameters, with no retrieval or fine-tuning involved. We show that the prompting methodology is as important as the model architecture: while the instruction-tuned model version achieves 0.5681 with its chat interface, the base model achieves 0.6836 when prompted using text completion. Thus, instruction tuning decreases factual recall; we refer to this effect as the instruction tax, which is caused by the model's weights rather than the prompting method. Our final solution is fairly straightforward: we prompt the base model with some examples from the training data, generate 64--256 outputs, and retain only the repeated ones. Two specialized methods are then applied for each relation: one improves the recall of large answer sets, and the other verifies a person's vitality before predicting their place of death.

papers.title_en: Prompt Sensitivity in Tool-Augmented Model Comparisons
papers.evidence: 模型比较中的提示敏感性与措辞
papers.tldr: 本研究探讨了为语言模型配备工具是否能提高问答基准测试中模型比较的稳定性。作者提出了一种匹配协议，将工具调用过程拆分为多个步骤，对六个开源模型在五个领域和五种表述下进行评估。研究发现，工具虽然能提升准确率，但往往会扩大模型成对比较对问题表述的敏感性，且这种敏感性受调用频率、接口及指令的影响。
papers.abstract_en: Language models are compared on question-answering benchmarks that pose each question in one wording, and a reworded question can change which of two models scores higher. We ask whether giving the models tools makes such comparisons more stable. An accuracy gain cannot answer this, because tools change several steps between the question and the scored answer at once. We propose a matched protocol that separates those steps: the answer readout, reasoning, the decision to call, the tool's answer, and the report supplied without a call. We apply it to six open models in five domains under five wordings. We find that tools raise accuracy where a program answers the question and widen the wording sensitivity of many pairwise comparisons. The widening follows how often a model calls, and call frequency follows the wording for some models and not others. It also depends on the interface and the instructions: a native tool-calling interface and a second tool description leave no detected widening in molecules, and sensitivity persists where tools return intermediate results. These findings show that deterministic reports do not guarantee stable comparisons. We recommend reporting call frequency and comparison stability under several wordings beside accuracy.

papers.title_en: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
papers.authors: Xun Sun, Thanh Thi Nguyen, Thuy-Trang Vu
papers.evidence: 在持续学习中使用提示词和上下文学习
papers.tldr: 持续学习旨在使模型不断获取新知识而不遗忘旧能力。为结合参数化与非参数化方法的优势，本文提出了HERD（骨架演进递归蒸馏）框架。它在骨架层不断提炼技能并保留高残差样本，在参数层通过双锚点漂移约束蒸馏将经验内化为累积能力，在固定资源下实现了出色的新任务适应性与极低的遗忘率。
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive runs. On the 25-stage task stream of TRACE+17, under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while exhibiting the least forgetting and the strongest retention of general capabilities.

papers.title_en: WRDO: Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization in Aligned Language Models
papers.authors: Grigoriy Evseev, Vladimir Solodkin, Dmitry Bylinkin, Daniil Medyakov, Vladimir Aletov, Aleksandr Beznosikov
papers.evidence: 结合特定提示方向进行优化
papers.tldr: 大语言模型的拒绝行为通常由单一的残差流方向介导，但传统方法将异质有害提示聚合成单一平均向量忽略了多样性。为此，本文提出了加权拒绝方向优化（WRDO）方法，通过学习聚合权重组合特定提示的拒绝方向，从而更有效、更灵活地干预和操纵模型的拒绝表征。
papers.abstract_en: Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further measure the effect of the intervention on general model capability through standard utility benchmarks. Finally, we investigate a defense-oriented setting in which the same optimization machinery is used in reverse to restore refusal behavior in an abliterated model checkpoint. Our results show that weighted aggregation provides a more effective and flexible mechanism for manipulating refusal representations.

papers.title_en: CVP-BAA: Efficiently Adapting Segment Anything Model for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Mei Wang, Minghui Li, Libin Lan
papers.evidence: 包含提示微调在内的参数高效微调
papers.tldr: 该论文提出了CVP-BAA方法，旨在高效适配Segment Anything Model（SAM）用于医学图像分割。针对传统PEFT方法对局部细节敏感度不足的问题，该方法通过引入卷积视觉提示和边界感知适配器，有效结合了局部结构先验与全局上下文，显著提升了医学图像中器官和病灶的边界分割精度。
papers.abstract_en: Various task-specific medical segmentation models have demonstrated strong performance, their heavy reliance on extensive annotations and highly specialized architectures limits their versatility, scalability, and clinical applicability. Recently, adapting vision foundation models, particularly the segment anything model (SAM), has emerged as a promising alternative. However, prevalent parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategies, such as prompt tuning and adapter tuning, often lack an explicit mechanism to embed local structural priors into the long-range dependency modeling of vision transformers (ViT), rendering them insufficiently sensitive to fine-grained details. To address these limitations, we introduce CVP-BAA, a novel hybrid PEFT method that improves SAM's sensitivity to domain-specific textures and local details, leading to superior boundary delineation. The proposed CVP-BAA adopts two key ideas. First, it introduces a convolutional visual prompting (CVP) strategy that leverages convolutional features as structural priors, prepending them to the key and value projections within the multi-head self-attention layers of strategically selected ViT blocks. Through a dedicated prompt generation-and-injection module, this mechanism effectively bridges local spatial details with global context semantics. Second, a boundary-aware adapter (BAA) is designed as a parallel branch to the feed-forward network within the same selected blocks. By explicitly computing and amplifying high-frequency components, the BAA enhances feature representations along tissue boundaries and fine-grained lesion structures. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks across three imaging modalities demonstrate that CVP-BAA achieves superior segmentation performance, surpassing existing task-specific models and PEFT-based SAM adaptations in both quantitative metrics and qualitative results.
